weapons.name: Wailing Blade
weapons.key_strength: Highest raw damage in the game. Cleave hits 3 targets per swing.

weapons.name: Ignited Bow
weapons.key_strength: Fire arrows + range = safest DPS in the game.

weapons.name: Noble Sword
weapons.key_strength: Fast attack speed, pairs with shield for balanced offense/defense.

weapons.name: Scorching Wand
weapons.key_strength: Fireball AoE with good INT scaling. Mainhand for Battlemage.

weapons.name: Fell Axe
weapons.key_strength: Charged attack breaks enemy armor. Devastating against high-HP targets.

weapons.name: Hunter's Crossbow
weapons.key_strength: Highest single-shot damage of any ranged weapon.

weapons.name: Guardian Shield
weapons.key_strength: Best parry window + block stamina reduction. Essential for sword-and-board.

weapons.name: Scavenger Spear
weapons.key_strength: Longest melee range. Safe poking from behind shield.

weapons.name: Shroud Staff
weapons.key_strength: Slow + poison effects. Long cast times but powerful crowd control.

weapons.name: Reinforced Mace
weapons.key_strength: Blunt damage ignores armor. Counters heavily armored foes.

weapons.name: Throwing Daggers
weapons.key_strength: Quick ranged option with no ammo cost. Great for pulling enemies.

weapons.name: Wooden Staff
weapons.key_strength: Low damage but only early magic option. Replace with wand ASAP.

weapons.name: Rusty Sword
weapons.key_strength: Your starting weapon. Replace immediately after tutorial.
